required_input: formal matrix SUCCESS.json plus 25 complete 54,000-row prediction ledgers
primary_output: grand mean and descriptive upstream/downstream/interaction variance decomposition
uncertainty: 10,000 document-cluster composition-sensitivity draws retaining all 25 cells
reporting_boundary: Fixed-seed descriptive components and document-composition sensitivity; not population variance components or population confidence intervals
no_role_boundary: no_role is an inference ablation and cannot be renamed a separately retrained label-blind system
stopping_rule: Analyze all 25 successful cells or report an integrity failure; no favorable-cell selection
